ACTION-ROLE-TRANSFER-IMPLEMENT.action: Implement and independently qualify the isolated ROLE-TRANSFER-001 generator, four-arm trainer, full-preclip norm controls, exact-resume state, clean-room evaluator, sealed commitments, and no-overlap proofs. This action does not authorize an official training arm or sealed evaluation.

ACTION-ROLE-TRANSFER-REVIEW.action: Only after every frozen ROLE-TRANSFER-001 readiness requirement passes may a separate authorization review consider the preregistered campaign. Preregistration and protocol-hash CI alone are not authorization or scientific evidence.

ACTION-NATURAL-SCALE-TRANSFER.action: Design, but do not automatically authorize, a clean natural-language/larger-scale transfer study. CS-TRANSFER-001 does not count as this evidence.
